reviews.author: Sterling foley

reviews.title: Died after a month and a half.
reviews.comment: I waited to review this PSU, turns out, I didn't have to wait long. I bought this power supply for a new build, it worked fine for about a month and a half and then started having problems starting up. It would take a few times unplugging and plugging it back in to get it to fire up, and then it finally wouldn't start. I replaced it with a MSI 850w and haven't had any problems with the new PSU. Just save your $$$ and buy something better.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer
